text:
```yaml
name: Close inactive issues

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Run daily at midnight UTC

permissions:
  issues: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  close_inactive_issues:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: close_inactive_issues
      cancel-in-progress: true
    steps:
      - name: Close stale issues
        uses: actions/stale@v10
        with:
          repo-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been marked as stale due to 700 days of inactivity. It will be closed in 30 days if no further activity occurs.
          close-issue-message: |
            Closing this issue due to 700 days of inactivity.
          days-before-stale: 700
          days-before-issue-stale: 700
          days-before-pr-stale: -1
          days-before-close: 30
          days-before-issue-close: 30
          days-before-pr-close: -1
          stale-issue-label: stale
          close-issue-label: closed
          exempt-issue-labels: data-issue
          close-issue-reason: not_planned
```
